items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1969-03-24
items.q: That's Thomas Anton and Ian Wheeler of England. But they got his Burgundy Street down

ctx.x: What was it about his style that you liked?

George was a big fan. Well, I think it's a style he created himself. Now, I don't say it's the same style as Johnny Dodds, but I think it's a style that he created himself. And it's two boys that I know, I think that's got that same touch, just by listening to his recordings. That's Thomas Anton and Ian Wheeler of England. But they got his Burgundy Street down, Burgundy
Blue's Pat. What did you think of George's tone?
